learning_objective: 🎯 Dive into the world of decimals to understand money, precise measurements, and fractions hidden beyond the whole numbers!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: The decimal point is a tiny dot that acts as a wall. On the left side, we have whole numbers, and on the right side, we have fractions or parts of a whole!
If you slice a pizza into 10 pieces, one piece is a tenth (0.1). If you slice it into 100 tiny crumbs, one crumb is a hundredth (0.01). Decimals help us write these small parts easily.
We use decimals every single day without realizing it! When you see a price tag of ₹99.50 or check your fever at 98.6 degrees, you are reading decimals.

fun_activity.title: 🧩 The Grocery Detective
fun_activity.instructions: Find an old shopping bill in your house. Circle every decimal number you see and write down the total amount of paise hiding after the decimal points!

quick_recap: ⭐ The decimal point separates whole units from fractional parts.
⭐ The first place after the decimal is tenths, followed by hundredths and thousandths.
⭐ We use decimals constantly for money, weight, distance, and temperature.
